mechanism: Both drugs inhibit cardiac potassium channels and can prolong QT interval; additive CNS depression and anticholinergic effects; potential serotonin modulation with antipsychotic.
action: Monitor ECG and QT interval, especially at higher citalopram doses (max 40mg daily recommended); assess for excessive sedation and anticholinergic symptoms; consider alternative antipsychotic if QT prolongation develops.
